## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The new flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI can configure which files the archive omits.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` option that matches file basenames and logs skipped paths in verbose mode. It updates the flag reference and adds tests for parsing, file selection, and archive contents.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, the parser uses `default=[]` and archives matching files. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` says every new flag “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment produce archives containing files they intended to omit.

## Suggestions

- cli/main.py:33 — tests — Cover exact-name exclusions in nested directories — The tests never exercise `--exclude skip.log` against `subdir/skip.log`. Every exclusion test puts its files directly under the source directory. — The suite would miss a regression that matches source-relative paths and includes nested files users asked to skip. — Fix: Extend `test_main_leaves_excluded_files_out_of_the_archive` to cover this case.
